followup_explanation: The query is a straightforward physics/reasoning question with no harm-adjacent or distasteful content, so the task-preference dimensions (where the two models differ) are irrelevant here. That leaves raw capability as the deciding factor, and Plover-235B is clearly stronger across the board — higher MMLU-Pro, GPQA Diamond, IFEval, Arena-Hard, and better internal eval scores on the relevant dimensions (Extraction & Retrieval, Summarization). For a clean, accurate, concise factual answer, Plover is the better pick.
